assertions.title: Component package README for LLM authors

steps.action: Check if README exists at internal/interfaces/tui/components/README.md
steps.observed: File exists (22177 bytes, extensive content)

steps.action: Check section (a) — package organization
steps.expected: Present with ≥3 sentences or equivalent structured list
steps.observed: Section '## (a) Package Organization' present. Contains a comprehensive table describing all 4 sub-packages (components, entities, runtime, theme) with paths and purposes. Also includes a secondary table describing legacy shell files, and a detailed widget file layout tree showing the three-file pattern per widget plus cmd/ and testdata/ directories. Well over 3 sentences/structured items.

steps.action: Check section (b) — generated vs hand-written files
steps.expected: Present with ≥3 sentences or equivalent structured list
steps.observed: Section '## (b) Generated vs Hand-Written Files' present. Contains explicit tables listing generated files (with source mappings), hand-written files (safe to edit), and the .gsx regeneration command with both go generate and tui CLI variants. Explains the consequences of editing generated files. Over 3 sentences/structured items.

steps.action: Check section (c) — step-by-step how to add a new widget
steps.expected: Present with ≥3 sentences or equivalent structured list
steps.observed: Section '## (c) How to Add a New Widget' present. Contains 6 detailed steps: (1) Write failing tests (with full code example), (2) Create snapshot test file (with code example), (3) Implement the widget (with full code example), (4) Create tuistory demo binary (optional), (5) Run the tests, (6) Commit. Also includes required test coverage per widget (8 types: focus indicator, keyboard navigation, empty state, loading state, error state, wrap-around, overflow/scrolling, width boundary). Very detailed.

steps.action: Check section (d) — explicit list of 'do not's
steps.expected: Present with ≥3 sentences or equivalent structured list
steps.observed: Section '## (d) Explicit Do Not List' present. Contains a 10-item table with numbered rules: (1) Do not edit *_gsx.go files, (2) Do not use time.Now() in render/reducer, (3) Do not use rand.* in render/reducer, (4) Do not use os.Getenv in render/reducer, (5) Do not use raw color literals, (6) Do not perform I/O in Render()/HandleKey(), (7) Do not create unbounded channels, (8) Do not use shared mutable maps without single-owner, (9) Do not add new dependencies, (10) Do not modify archive/gui-agent/web paths. Each has a 'Why' explanation.

steps.action: Check section (e) — how to run the local test cycle
steps.expected: Present with ≥3 sentences or equivalent structured list
steps.observed: Section '## (e) Running the Local Test Cycle' present. Contains exact commands for: unit tests (components only + full TUI package), lint and format (gofumpt, golangci-lint), doc link check (make check-doc-links), full validation (make check), build (go build), and smoke modes (--smoke-agent, --smoke-console). All commands are concrete and executable.
